profile.headline: Product-Focused Software Engineer | Applied AI & Backend Systems
profile.summary:
Product-minded software engineer with experience building applied AI systems in production. I’ve worked on features and internal tooling that support real business workflows, often in small teams with limited structure.

I enjoy working close to product decisions and people. I like collaborating across engineering, product, and operations to turn unclear goals into concrete plans, think through tradeoffs, and iterate based on how systems actually behave in the real world.

Earlier in my career, I worked in clinical research and regulatory environments, which shaped how I think about reliability, edge cases, and coordination across teams. I’m motivated by roles where technical depth and product judgment come together to build systems people can depend on.

Contact: rebeccamsmith29@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected backend systems with Ruby on Rails, contributing to improved performance and scalability across core services.
• Led full project lifecycles from idea conception to deployment for high-impact features. Translated vague product goals into technical plans, created tickets, and delivered robust solutions.
• Designed and implemented an AI-powered lead intent analyzer that uses OpenAI's assistant API to extract actionable data from phone call transcripts, text messages, and other lead communication. This reduced manual triage time and improved lead quality for contractors.
• Built an automated outbound text messaging system to follow up with leads according to our 30 day SOP, saving time and effort for the sales team. 
• Developed and maintained web scraping pipelines for enriching lead data from real estate sites like Zillow and Redfin, using structured data to drive smarter lead-to-business matching.
Built dynamic lead routing logic based on zip codes, business rules, and service availability, significantly increasing conversion by optimizing which company receives each lead.
• Actively collaborated with design and product teams on early-stage feature exploration, breaking down complex problems into clear, actionable development work.
• Led refactoring initiatives, improved test coverage, and participated in data architecture planning, increasing code maintainability and stability.
• Supported production stability by handling debugging and triaging incoming support issues, resulting in faster resolution times and improved user trust.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved application performance and decreased page load times by locating and optimizing inefficient
database queries using New Relic performance monitoring
• Implemented an internal webhook system for external developers to subscribe to; managed through a public
GraphQL API or frontend web GUI built with Nuxt JS
• Handled support issues by investigation and/or data manipulation and proposed improvements to
documentation to standardize processes for new engineers
• Collaborated with Product, QA, and Design in an agile workflow to add features and maintain consistent code
across applications
• Experience with MVC and knowledge of data modeling in a Postgres relational database
• Worked in a containerized development environment using Docker
• Wrote code with test coverage using RSpec and Jest testing frameworks.
• Refactoring, debugging, pair programming, and writing code using object oriented programming principles
• Member of the diversity and inclusion group
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Postgres · GraphQL · Docker · SQL · Jest · RSpec · Ruby · Vue.js · Git · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Nuxt.js

positions.title: Research Associate, Product Development
positions.description:
· New Drug Application preparation and submission
· Managed and collaborated with vendors assisting with NDA preparation in order to deliver highly accurate clinical documents on a tight deadline
· Acted as a cross-functional liaison on multiple clinical research studies
· Lead and prepared data for data monitoring committee meetings for ongoing clinical trials
· Detailed QC and review of clinical documents

positions.title: Regulatory Specialist
positions.description:
· Monitored regulatory change required by new and revised laws and regulations, communicating complex protocols into informed consent forms and determining operational impacts.
· Completed regulatory submissions, prepared for QA and FDA audits, organized protocol training for staff to ensure timely opening of clinical trials, worked with finance to create tiered pricing for amendment processing based on effort tracking, trained new employees.

positions.title: Clinical Data Specialist - Phase 1 Oncology
positions.description:
· Reviewing inclusion/exclusion criteria, reading medical charts, and entering data on new subjects; if they meet registration requirements in research study, enrolling subjects and instructing them in protocol procedures. Submitting confidential records and research materials to study group reviewers at other institutions when applicable.  
· Working on a team with two coordinators to manage the dynamic and complex nature of Phase 1 studies. 
· Obtaining informed consent from subjects per GCP guidelines. 
· Assessing and documenting subjects' response to treatment through physical assessment and/or data analysis; reporting any evidence of toxicity to drugs or chemicals used in treatment of subjects.  
· Reviewing data to determine treatment modifications and alterations between research study plan and actual subject care with physicians.  
· Educating clinic nurses on managing patients according to study procedures per protocol. 
· Managing timely query resolution with CRAs.  
· Attending study-related weekly meetings with physicians to discuss patient care, adverse events, SAE’s, and to update RANO/RECIST forms. 
· Purchasing office equipment and laboratory supplies maintaining inventory and expense records.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Determined that there is a relationship between virus propagation and the catalytic activity of an antibiotic resistance gene, TEM-1, using Phage Assisted Continuous Evolution technology. 
•	Optimized the PACE technology to avoid common problems

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Studied leukemia by successfully creating transgenic zebrafish models that are susceptible to lymphocytic cancer by microinjecting embryos with transgenes.
•	Used CRISPR technology in human cell culture to modify a cohesion protein, ESCO1, for the purpose of ascertaining if it has a different function than the similar protein ESCO2.
•	Created a knock out protein to determine that the mitochondrial transport protein MICU1 decreases stem properties of ovarian cancer cells.
